note: Barbados: every non-national must register with the Immigration Department before starting work, on a work permit the employer or sponsor applies for: short-term (up to eleven months) or long-term (Immigration Act, Cap. 190, s. 17). No days of work without it are named. CARICOM artistes and musicians of the participating states work on the Skills Certificate (the csme list).

sources.title: Barbados Immigration Department, Work Permits: Section 17 of the Immigration Act, Cap. 190
sources.said: All non-nationals desirous of working in Barbados are required to register with immigration prior to commencing employment. ... Short-Term work permits are valid for a period up to eleven months. The employer or 'sponsor' has the responsibility to make the application on behalf of the employee.
